title: Road to Champ 5
transcript: I keep on failing. I've been trying to become a chess champion for a year now. In Amsterdam, in Rome, on the Isle of Wight, [music] at the Grand Chess Festival, and every single time I failed. I am becoming stronger, but it seems like [music] it's never enough. Maybe I should just resign. >> This time, you won't be alone. This pawn [music] symbolizes hope. But you will need all the other pieces to get [music] stronger. Go and find them. >> [music] >> You're still missing [music] the king. >> No, I got it. >> [music] [laughter]
